entries.question: How is JAMB scored?
entries.answer: JAMB (UTME) has 4 subjects, each scored out of 100, for a total out of 400. English is compulsory. Your score is based on correct answers — there's no negative marking, so always attempt every question.

entries.question: Explain photosynthesis simply
entries.answer: Photosynthesis is how plants make their own food. Using sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide, plants produce glucose (sugar for energy) and release oxygen. It mostly happens in the leaves, inside the chloroplast.

entries.question: How can a student start earning online?
entries.answer: Low-cost ways to start: 1) Freelance a skill you already have (writing, design, data entry). 2) Sell a digital skill via WhatsApp status. 3) Affiliate marketing. 4) Offer a service to fellow students (typing, tutoring). Start with what needs zero capital first.

entries.question: What can this bot do?
entries.answer: BUKASON helps with Academics (JAMB/WAEC/NECO, explaining topics) and Business (low-capital ways to earn as a student). Switch modes at the top, and ask anything in plain language.
